formula_audit.independent_derivation: CE(a,y)=logsumexp(a)-a_y. The logsumexp difference is log(sum_j exp(a_Fj)*exp(delta_j)/sum_j exp(a_Fj))=log E_pF exp(delta).
assumptions: Identical target for each paired term.
Finite complete logits and the actual softmax vocabulary.
Matched parameters/initial state/event-tape intervention defines the scientific contrast; the algebra alone does not ensure an identifying intervention.
formula_audit.boundary: A finite event-path task contrast is not a sum of individual spike causal effects. NLL scalars determine the total contrast but not its alignment and KL components.

formula_audit.independent_derivation: log p_Hj-log p_Fj=delta_j-log E_pF exp(delta). Averaging its negative under p_F gives KL(p_F||p_H)=log E_pF exp(delta)-E_pF delta; subtract A to obtain the CE contrast.
formula_audit.sign_rule: Exact benefit iff A>KL. A<=0 implies nonbenefit because KL>=0; positive A can still be outweighed by KL. Event/task sign is local to the matched target and reference branch.
formula_audit.gauge: Adding one scalar to all vocabulary logits per event leaves probabilities, A, KL and CE differences invariant. A vocabulary-vector time mean is not this gauge and must be retained.
formula_audit.boundary: KL is a probability divergence/finite softmax curvature contribution, not thermodynamic entropy flow. A/KL for B-A or C-A must use the corresponding A reference distribution, not B-C p_F indiscriminately.

formula_audit.independent_derivation: d(r/rho)=dr/rho-r*(r^T dr)/(d*rho^3), since d rho=(r^T dr)/(d rho). Multiplying by fixed D_gamma gives the displayed Jacobian.
formula_audit.eigenspace_boundary: Before D_gamma and for r nonzero, tangential gain is1/rho and radial gain isepsilon/rho^3. At positive epsilon both are positive, so there is no exact radial null in this pre-gain Jacobian. At r=0 the Jacobian is I/sqrt(epsilon) before gain. Anisotropic or zero gain changes the full-map singular directions.
formula_audit.finite_boundary: Exact finite normalization endpoints and the actual epsilon/gain are needed; a local radial/tangent linearization cannot assign an entire finite event contrast. Directional codes may remain useful despite radial attenuation.

formula_audit.formula: d CE=(p-onehot(y))^T W_dec J_norm(r) W_read d h
formula_audit.conditions: Fixed W_read/W_dec/b/gain/epsilon, a differentiable read branch and correct sealed target. Changed head/gain requires additional terms; finite threshold changes use the exact CE identity instead.
formula_audit.boundary: Task alignment weights the observed contrast. State/logit norm, low rank, spike count or physical energy alone cannot replace this signed task effect.

formula_audit.formula: Delta L=sum_intervals integral grad L_E(vartheta(lambda)) dot Delta d lambda + sum_boundaries[L_plus-L_minus]
formula_audit.independent_derivation: For the scalar path f(lambda)=L(vartheta0+lambda*Delta), integrate its derivative on every absolutely continuous fixed-event interval and telescope the one-sided endpoint values across all boundaries.
assumptions: The parameter path is feasible/differentiable and the same complete entering state and head define the loss.
There are finitely many event/other discontinuity boundaries for this finite unroll, integrable path derivatives on intervals, and finite one-sided loss limits.
Within intervals the complete path loss is piecewise C1 or absolutely continuous with the appropriate almost-everywhere chain derivative.
Simultaneous crossings and induced cascades are grouped as one aggregate boundary. Other discontinuities are included; continuous clamp/gate breakpoints contribute zero jump.
Endpoint values L(0),L(1) match the chosen one-sided branch values, or any endpoint convention jumps are explicitly included.
formula_audit.boundary: Finite/transverse boundary conditions are a mathematical hypothesis, not measured properties of this saved step. The endpoint H/F event-tape contrast includes downstream continuous trajectory consequences and is generally not the path jump sum. The narrower planned trace does not enumerate path boundaries or claim to estimate that sum.

This is exact endpoint accounting for a defined intervention. Holding all original events fixed is an artificial counterfactual; it does not isolate reset, clamp, optimizer moments or biological event-credit law.

accepted_claims.claim: Existing attribution remains unresolved while the finite fixed-event descent and local event-associated hard-fit reversal are measured.

support.scope: Immutable preceding diagnosis: one available outcome report, 96 unique positions, reused deterministic counterfactuals. No new outcome or NLL decomposition terms were measured in this offline followup.

accepted_claims.claim: The same actual body step can worsen retrospective hard fit and improve conditional following32.
accepted_claims.support: The risks have different targets and entering states/horizons; the two observed signs do not logically contradict each other.

accepted_claims.claim: The chosen observable/read geometry and the task-weighted finite event contrast are useful missing identifying objects.
accepted_claims.support: The current record measures projected normalized feature variation and total loss contrasts, not a stage-wise propagated contrast or its A/KL terms.

accepted_claims.claim: A/B/C with fixed original head and old-fit-terminal following start is an adequate first measurement DESIGN for these particular contrasts.
accepted_claims.support: It can test geometric propagation/attenuation and current-head signed task effect while leaving event-credit versus saved-optimizer, entering-state derivative history and population heterogeneity open.

accepted_claims.claim: The narrower first trace does not require an extra current-SG direction or scale search.
accepted_claims.support: Those are required only for optimizer-specific direction attribution, an explicitly deferred question; the necessity appendix and plan committee agree on this narrower scope.

accepted_claims.claim: Alternative observables and learning laws remain possible directions, conditional on a future distinguishing result.
accepted_claims.support: Non-injectivity of reset and projection null directions are possible contrast losses; sufficient semantic information and usefulness require an adequate matched decoder/calibration and independent task evidence.

rejected_claims.claim: Offline formulas establish reset/RMSNorm/Adam as the global or unique root cause.

rejected_claims.claim: Low normalized-feature variation or a nearly common current head proves absent motor information or a globally defective read.
rejected_claims.reason: The observed object is RMSNorm(W_read h), and current-head loss does not estimate Bayes information or decoder-class adequacy. Raw cross-stage norm ratios also depend on coordinates.
rejected_claims.affirmative_boundary: Report current-coordinate variation and measure resolution at each map with its own floors.

rejected_claims.reason: It is a full event-tape counterfactual and includes recurrent downstream continuous interactions.
rejected_claims.affirmative_boundary: Use the exact endpoint CE/KL-minus-alignment decomposition; conditional path accounting remains separate.
